blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Real-time OS correctness depends on deadlines, not just average response speed.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: Embedded and distributed refer to system architecture and purpose; each can overlap with real-time.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Multi-user concerns people/account isolation, whereas multitasking concerns processes.
